tasks.goal: You have a new bookcase in the hall with four shelves. Get it into the app.

lostMoments.words: I am looking at a screen that draws all three of my bookcases and there is nothing on it, top or bottom, that offers to add a fourth. The only thing left untried is a round icon in the corner drawn as a person's head and shoulders, which reads as an account or profile button, not as furniture.

I have typed the name and there is one Save on the screen, but it sits inside a different card, the one headed 'Nothing yet: it has no areas on it' with a line reading 'What it will be called'. I cannot tell whether pressing it saves the name I typed or creates a shelf, and the two fields above it have no button of their own.

verdict.goal: You have a new bookcase in the hall with four shelves. Get it into the app.

parts.what: a bookcase the world did not have
it is recognisable as the hall one

tasks.goal: The comics should live on the bottom shelf of the hall bookcase, and only comics.

lostMoments.words: The app will not let me say comics belong on this shelf: 'A rule can only ask for a tag some book already carries, so tag a book with it first.' My comics are in a box in the hall, not in the app yet, and setting the shelf up before I carry them over is the whole reason I am here. Nothing on screen tells me how to make the tag exist.

The confirmation said this shelf would stop taking non-fiction overflow and begin a stretch of its own. I pressed Write it down, it answered 'Nothing changed about where the books belong', and the card above it still reads 'Non-fiction, carrying on. Tagged Non-fiction'. Nothing at all was written: I checked the shelf afterwards and it is unchanged.

verdict.goal: The comics should live on the bottom shelf of the hall bookcase, and only comics.

parts.what: there is a bottom shelf on the hall bookcase
the app records that comics belong there
nothing that is not a comic stands there

tasks.goal: Move every non-fiction book off bookcase 4 and onto bookcase 3, and record that you have carried them.
